# Energy Quantization (Bohr Formulation)

Energy levels in a bound atomic system are discrete rather than continuous. Niels Bohr accounted for the Rydberg formula by demonstrating that electron orbits are constrained to quantized angular momentum $L = n\hbar$, yielding discrete stationary energy states $E_n = -\frac{13.6\,\text{eV}}{n^2}$.
